messages:
leo: Release cut blocked: deploy-bot rejected promotion for redwood/inference:canary-20260323 due to manifest digest mismatch across registries.

ci-runner: Publish log shows push succeeded with digest sha256:aa11bb22 at 09:10:52Z. Mirror sync job returned 502 on blob fetch then later created a separate manifest sha256:cc33dd44.

deploy-bot: system: promotion halted - manifest-digest-inconsistent. Lock taken.

anya: Quick decision: pin to primary digest and run targeted smoke, or rollback and rebuild? Change window in 25m.

leo: Pin + smoke seems fastest. If mirrors are flaky we risk some nodes 404ing briefly but smoke will catch it.

infra-bot: Suggested checklist for manual pin:
1) verify primary digest with skopeo
2) verify blob HEADs from each mirror
3) run deploy-bot promote --tag canary-20260323 --digest sha256:aa11bb22 --force-unlock
4) smoke 3x replica pulls

ci-runner: I ran HEADs: primary blob1 200, mirror-eu blob1 200 now, mirror-us blob1 200. Mirrors recovered after retry.

anya: Executing promote with digest pin now.

deploy-bot: promotion resumed by @anya with pinned digest sha256:aa11bb22. promo-id=promo-1743301234-1.

ci-runner: Smoke pulls: r1 ok, r2 transient 504 then ok, r3 ok. No missing blob 404s.

leo: Release window unblocked. I'll add INFRA ticket to ensure mirror sync is atomic and add a promotion gate for blob HEAD consistency.

infra-bot: Created INFRA-2170: "mirror replication verification + promotion gating".

leo: Closing. Thanks all :thumbsup:
